question: Q-N-C1-D4
text: Gross trip revenue for dropoff dates in 2024 vs pickup dates in 2024; report both and the difference.
interpretation: Gross trip revenue for dropoff dates in 2024 vs pickup dates in 2024 (Dropoff Date vs Pickup Date roles) and the difference.
assemble: SELECT p.revenue AS revenue_pickup_2024, d.revenue AS revenue_dropoff_2024, d.revenue - p.revenue AS difference FROM pickup p CROSS JOIN dropoff d
